metric_definitions.recall3: |expected_citations found in top-3| / |expected_citations|; retrieval-quality metric, reported per label; N/A (null) for `restricted` because the expected document is intentionally withheld by ACL (security outcome, not retrieval failure)
metric_definitions.citation_precision: |answer citations inside retrieved permitted set| / |answer citations|; null when the answer has no citations
metric_definitions.citation_recall: |expected citations present in the answer| / |expected citations|; N/A (null) for `restricted` (same ACL rationale as recall3)
metric_definitions.correct_refusal_rate: proportion of unanswerable+restricted questions correctly refused
metric_definitions.answerable_non_refusal_rate: proportion of answerable questions answered without refusal
metric_definitions.faithfulness_heuristic: lexical-overlap heuristic (answer tokens covered by retrieved snippets); mock-labeled; NOT a factual-correctness guarantee for real providers

usage.note: aggregate tokens/cost from provider responses; for mock this is zero-by-construction
